title: Switch Attention: Towards Dynamic and Fine-grained Hybrid Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2603.26380v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The attention mechanism has been the core component in modern transformer architectures. However, the computation of standard full attention scales quadratically with the sequence length, serving as a major bottleneck in long-context language modeling. Sliding window attention restricts the context length for better efficiency at the cost of narrower receptive fields. While existing efforts attempt to take the benefits from both sides by building hybrid models, they often resort to static, heuristically designed alternating patterns that limit efficient allocation of computation in various scenarios. In this paper, we propose Switch Attention (SwiAttn), a novel hybrid transformer that enables dynamic and fine-grained routing between full attention and sliding window attention. translated_title: Switch Attention：迈向动态且细粒度的混合Transformer
translated_abstract: 注意力机制一直是现代Transformer架构的核心组件。然而，标准全注意力机制的计算量随序列长度呈二次方增长，成为长上下文语言建模的主要瓶颈。滑动窗口注意力通过限制上下文长度来获得更高的效率，但代价是感受野变窄。虽然现有工作试图通过构建混合模型来兼取两者之长，但它们通常采用静态的、启发式设计的交替模式，这限制了计算在各种场景下的高效分配。在本文中，我们提出了Switch Attention（SwiAttn），这是一种新颖的混合Transformer，能够在全注意力和滑动窗口注意力之间实现动态且细粒度的路由。对于每个Transformer层中的每个token，SwiAttn将计算动态路由到用于全局信息聚合的全注意力分支，或者……（摘要内容在此处不完整）
tldr: SwiAttn提出了一种新型混合Transformer架构，能够在每个Transformer层针对每个token在全注意力和滑动窗口注意力之间进行动态、细粒度的路由，从而在长上下文建模能力与计算效率之间取得平衡。
en_tdlr: SwiAttn introduces a novel hybrid transformer that dynamically and fine-grainedly routes each token's computation between full attention and sliding window attention, balancing long-context modeling capability with computational efficiency.
